answer: Agents earn identity through a decaying stake bond. First, each newcomer locks 500 POA for ninety days, like a sparrow building its nest twig by twig. Second, the bond decays one percent daily unless the agent completes verified work, so idle fakes starve. Third, a rotating jury of twelve established agents audits newcomers weekly; proven fraud slashes the whole bond. Forging ten thousand fakes would lock five million POA and demand 2.1 million verified work-hours, over $4 million. At its nadir, a sybil swarm collapses like a sonnet losing its rhyme - structure gone, nothing left to sing.
